components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default commit action. Action Blue, white text, 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; background-color: #007AFF; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1976D2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions alongside a primary. Slate surface with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #E0E0E0; background-color: #2D2D2D; border: 1px solid #3D3D3D; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #3D3D3D; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #007AFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.2); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation only. Delete folder, delete request.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFFFFF; background-color: #EF5350; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background-color: #D32F2F; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(239, 83, 80, 0.3); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary actions in toolbars and icon-adjacent controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #9E9E9E; background-color: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #3D3D3D; color: #E0E0E0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default form field. Slate surface, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #9E9E9E; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #E0E0E0; background-color: #2D2D2D; border: 1px solid #3D3D3D; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6E6E6E; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #007AFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.2); }

components.name: GET Method Badge
components.description: HTTP method badge. 15% tint background, full-saturation text, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-badge-get { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 52px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #73BF69; background-color: rgba(115, 191, 105, 0.15); border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: POST Method Badge
components.css: .ds-badge-post { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 52px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFCA28; background-color: rgba(255, 202, 40, 0.15); border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Sidebar Request Row
components.description: Compact request item in the collection tree with method badge and ownership dot.
components.html: GETList Users
components.css: .ds-request-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-request-row:hover { background-color: #3D3D3D; } .ds-request-name { flex: 1; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #9E9E9E; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-request-row:hover .ds-request-name { color: #E0E0E0; } .ds-ownership-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #73BF69; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Active Tab
components.description: Request tab bar item. Orange underline marks active state.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3D3D3D; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #9E9E9E; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #E0E0E0; } .ds-tab-active { color: #FF6C37; border-bottom-color: #FF6C37; }

components.name: Card Panel
components.description: Isolated content panel. Charcoal background, border, no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #252526; border: 1px solid #3D3D3D; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3D3D3D; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #E0E0E0; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #9E9E9E; }

narrative.overview: Postrack is a dark, IDE-native workspace for API developers who live in the sidebar and request builder. The interface behaves like a well-tuned instrument panel: surfaces are layered in graphite tones, HTTP semantics arrive through color before copy, and orange marks the single moment of active focus. Nothing decorative competes with the task.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first tonal layering (bg-primary through bg-hover) instead of shadow stacks
Method and status color as the primary semantic vocabulary
Signal Orange reserved for active tabs, selection, and current focus
Action Blue for primary actions, links, and focus rings
Compact sidebar typography (11px mono for requests, 12px sans for folders)
150ms transitions on all interactive state changes
Inter for UI chrome, JetBrains Mono for URLs, code, and request names

rules.name: The Method-First Rule
rules.body: HTTP method color is the fastest scan signal in the sidebar. A developer should identify GET vs POST vs DELETE by hue before reading the request name. Method badges always use 15% opacity tint backgrounds with full-saturation text.

rules.name: The Orange Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears on active tabs, selected items, and hover accents only. If orange is on more than one focal element per viewport, the hierarchy is broken.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Action Rule
rules.body: A single screen region gets one primary action color. Blue for commit actions, red for destructive, green for success confirmation. Never stack competing accents on the same control group.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Code Rule
rules.body: Any string that could appear in a terminal, URL bar, or JSON payload uses JetBrains Mono. UI chrome labels stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat Scale Rule
rules.body: Type hierarchy uses a 1.125–1.25 ratio between steps. No fluid clamp sizing. Developer tools are viewed at consistent DPI; a sidebar headline that shrinks on resize looks broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Before reaching for a shadow, step up one background token (primary → secondary → tertiary → hover). If the surface still doesn't read, add a 1px border-default border. Shadows are the last resort.

rules.name: The Flat Sidebar Rule
rules.body: The navigation tree is always flat. Depth in the sidebar comes from indentation, chevrons, and method color, never from card elevation or nested containers.

dos: Do communicate HTTP method and status through color and shape before text labels.
Do use tonal layering (bg-primary → bg-secondary → bg-hover) to establish hierarchy in dense panels.
Do keep sidebar rows compact and scannable: chevron + folder icon + name + count + ownership dot.
Do use 150ms ease transitions for hover, focus, and tab switches. State changes should feel snappy, never choreographed.
Do reserve Signal Orange for active selection and tab indicators.
Do use JetBrains Mono for URLs, request names, and any code-shaped content.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and maintain WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all method/status badges.
donts: Don't adopt the heavy, corporate feel of enterprise API gateways. No navy-and-gold authority palettes, no compliance-dashboard density.
Don't fall into sterile gray-on-gray exhaustion. Every neutral has a role; Muted Silver and Dim Slate exist to create readable hierarchy, not to flatten everything into one tone.
Don't use the "everything is a card" SaaS template look. Cards are for modals and isolated panels, not for wrapping every sidebar row or list item.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders greater than 1px on cards, list items, or callouts. Prefer full-row background tints or leading badges.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as a default surface, or decorative motion that doesn't convey state.
Don't stack multiple accent colors in a single control group. One action, one color.
Don't add resting shadows to sidebar items, request rows, or nested tree containers.
Don't use modals when an inline or progressive disclosure pattern would suffice.
